data.one_liner: Animated snack bar with icon, color, text, and programmatic dismissal
data.what_it_does: Shows a status message as a snack bar with an icon and optional animation. It supports custom colors, text styles, and dismissal control via a controller.
use_when: Displaying success, failure, or alert messages in a Flutter app
Need a snack bar with icon and color that follows the theme
Want programmatic dismissal or awaiting completion
avoid_when: Replacing complex custom UI components that require full screen overlays
Using it for non-snackbar notifications like dialogs or persistent banners
weaknesses: Only works as a snack bar, not a full-screen dialog
Limited to Flutter, no native platform integration
